boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 68 stacks two chambers vertically, separated by a horizontal dividing bar. The upper chamber holds a mix of green blocks, a large blue square, and orange/yellow pieces. The lower chamber is dominated by a massive purple rectangle with counter '7' wrapped in a red frame. Clear the entire upper chamber first — the dividing bar will not open until it empties. Then strip the red frame and feed the purple block through its exit seven times.
landmarks: Block Out Level 68 stacks two chambers vertically, separated by a horizontal dividing bar.
The upper chamber holds a mix of green blocks, a large blue square, and orange/yellow pieces.
The lower chamber is dominated by a massive purple rectangle with counter '7' wrapped in a red frame.
Clear the entire upper chamber first — the dividing bar will not open until it empties.

quickTips: Empty the upper chamber completely before touching the lower — the dividing bar will not open otherwise.
Strip the red frame around the purple block before feeding it through the exit.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the small blocks at the top of the upper chamber through the top exit.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Extract the green blocks on the left through the left exit.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Slide the large blue square block out through the right or top exit.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the orange/yellow blocks at the bottom of the upper chamber.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Once the upper chamber empties, the dividing bar opens — strip the red frame around the purple block.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the massive purple block (counter '7') through its exit repeatedly until fully cleared.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining cyan side pieces and bottom fragments.

failurePoints: Trying to move the purple block before the upper chamber is empty — the dividing bar is still sealed.
Forgetting to strip the red frame around the purple block before attempting to feed it.
